description: Defines the abstract class StreamingQueryManager for managing active streaming queries within a SparkSession, including methods for retrieving, waiting for termination, resetting, and managing listeners.

classes.name: StreamingQueryManager
classes.description: An abstract class to manage all active StreamingQuery instances in a SparkSession, providing methods for query retrieval, waiting for termination, listener management, and resetting state.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Returns an array of active StreamingQuery instances associated with this SQLContext.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an active StreamingQuery by UUID or String ID.

methods.name: awaitAnyTermination
methods.description: Blocks until any query terminates; throws exception if termination was due to an error.

methods.name: awaitAnyTermination
methods.description: Blocks until any query terminates or timeout occurs; returns true if a query terminates within the timeout.

methods.name: resetTerminated
methods.description: Clears the record of past terminated queries to allow waiting for new terminations.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a StreamingQueryListener to receive lifecycle event callbacks.

methods.name: listListeners
methods.description: Returns an array of all StreamingQueryListeners attached to this manager.
